TextView.android:text: 2.0-in rod consumes 25% of bore area, generating 25% less pull force but 1.33x faster retraction speed.
Recommend >= 20 HP internal combustion engine (or 15 HP electric motor) to account for 85% hydraulic pump mechanical efficiency at 3000 PSI.
Velocity is within the SAE recommended 10–15 ft/s window for working pressure lines. Pressure drop and heat generation are minimized.
